items.q: What should you remember about **Growing pains as blessing**?
items.a: **depression/low mood = misalignment signal; meant for more.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Armor, not numbness**?
items.a: **things still affect you;** skill is getting back to work.

items.q: What should you remember about **Power of separation**?
items.a: **craft/love of the work** ≠ how others receive it.

items.q: What should you remember about **Cry/celebrate one night**?
items.a: **bounded emotion → back** to training; no living off past wins.

items.q: What should you remember about **Kobe's peace**?
What should you remember about **Accept ≠ surrender**?
What should you remember about **Resistance creates tension**?
items.a: **fighting the flow blocks the next move.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Thread always exists**?
items.a: **desire in consciousness implies a path (not Saturn).**

items.q: What should you remember about **Present moment**?
items.a: **"one day closer to death"; attention on intention.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Attract vs chase**?
items.a: **chase encodes fleeing; attract magnetizes small→large goals.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Creation is the win**?
What should you remember about **Critics off-path**?
items.a: **controlling perception distracts; people-pleasing** loses self and still fails.
